# System Qualification Test Specification (SYS.5)
## HVAC Flap Actuator Prototype

**Branch:** hvdemo-142b  
**ASPICE Compliance:** Level-3  
**Document Version:** 1.0
**Date:** [Autogenerated]

---

## 1. Purpose and Scope
This document specifies the System Qualification Test Specification (SYS.5) for the HVAC flap actuator prototype. 
Tests are executed on hardware (bench setup) and validate the complete integrated system against all agreed automotive system requirements. 
All tests trace to System Requirement IDs per the traceability matrix in Section 4.

---

## 2. Test Environment and Prerequisites
- Test Hardware: STM32F407G-DISC1 board with Infineon TLE9851-based actuator circuit, UART, ADC, DC motor, potentiometer, status LEDs.
- Power Supply: Nominal (as required by the application board)
- Bench Setup: UART configured as test command interface, LEDs visible, ADC input connected to potentiometer feedback
- System flashed with release firmware to be validated

---

## 3. Test Case Specifications

### ******************************
### 1. Power-Up & Initialization
### ******************************

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-001
- **Mapped System Requirement ID(s):** SYS-REQ-020, SYS-REQ-021, SYS-REQ-022
- **Test Objective:** Verify proper initialization of all peripherals and safe start state of motor and position reading
- **Preconditions:** System fully powered OFF
- **Test Inputs:** Power ON event
- **Test Steps:**
  1. Power ON the system
  2. Observe LED, measure motor signals, and note UART/ADC readiness
- **Expected Results:**
  - Peripherals (UART, ADC, GPIO, PWM) ready
  - Motor state: OFF
  - Status LED (power) ON
  - System reads current flap position to determine initial state
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** All expected results observed

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-002
- **Mapped System Requirement ID(s):** SYS-REQ-017
- **Test Objective:** Verify dedicated LED indicates power ON
- **Preconditions:** System powered OFF
- **Test Inputs:** Power ON system
- **Test Steps:**
  1. Power ON system
  2. Observe dedicated power LED
- **Expected Results:** Power LED lights up and remains ON
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** Power LED ON immediately after power-up

### ******************************
### 2. Valid Flap Position Commands
### ******************************

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-003
- **Mapped System Requirements:** SYS-REQ-001, SYS-REQ-002, SYS-REQ-003, SYS-REQ-004, SYS-REQ-006, SYS-REQ-007
- **Objective:** Verify system correctly actuates the flap to all valid positions (0–5) per user command
- **Preconditions:** System powered ON, idle
- **Test Inputs:** UART commands: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (send one at a time)
- **Test Steps:**
  1. Send UART command for position (0–5)
  2. Observe motor operation and flap movement
  3. Observe that the system stops when position is reached
  4. Observe corresponding position LED
- **Expected Results:**
  - Flap moves to commanded position with proper direction
  - Motor halts at each position
  - No overshoot
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** Flap reaches each commanded position precisely, motor stops, no positions skipped or overshoot

### ******************************
### 3. Invalid & Boundary Conditions
### ******************************

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-004
- **Mapped System Requirements:** SYS-REQ-005, SYS-REQ-014, SYS-REQ-015, SYS-REQ-016, SYS-REQ-026
- **Objective:** System properly ignores out-of-range and malformed UART commands
- **Preconditions:** System powered ON, idle
- **Test Inputs:** UART commands: -1, 6, 'A', 99, '', 0xFE (invalid bytes)
- **Test Steps:**
  1. Inject each invalid command via UART
- **Expected Results:** System does NOT move flap, motor remains OFF, position & LEDs unchanged
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** All invalid inputs safely ignored, system stable

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-005
- **Mapped System Requirements:** SYS-REQ-038
- **Objective:** ADC position feedback is out of any valid range — system must stop motor and hold idle
- **Preconditions:** System powered ON, flap at valid position
- **Test Inputs:** Inject abnormal ADC signal (simulate open/short to Vcc/GND)
- **Test Steps:**
  1. Simulate ADC out-of-range value via hardware
- **Expected Results:** Motor OFF, system enters idle, no LEDs change state unnecessarily
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** System idles, motor OFF, no crash/hang

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-006
- **Mapped System Requirements:** SYS-REQ-033, SYS-REQ-039
- **Objective:** Command issued during ongoing flap movement or motor fails to reach target (stall)
- **Preconditions:** System executing a move
- **Test Inputs:** UART command for new position while prior move not complete
- **Test Steps:**
  1. During movement, issue another command
- **Expected Results:** Only one command handled at a time. System does not lock up or crash on motor stall.
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** System ignores overlapping commands, no reset/hang

### ******************************
### 4. Position Feedback & Monitoring
### ******************************

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-007
- **Mapped System Requirements:** SYS-REQ-009, SYS-REQ-010, SYS-REQ-011, SYS-REQ-012
- **Objective:** Verify ADC reading maps accurately to discrete positions and continuous feedback is used
- **Preconditions:** Flap at known position
- **Test Inputs:** Manually set flap to each position (0-5), observe ADC, command moves
- **Test Steps:**
  1. At each position, verify ADC reading matches mapped software range
- **Expected Results:** Feedback and mapping accurate, system tracks position changes
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** ADC ranges match position map, system responds accordingly

### ******************************
### 5. Motor Control Behavior
### ******************************

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-008
- **Mapped System Requirements:** SYS-REQ-008, SYS-REQ-029, SYS-REQ-030
- **Objective:** Motor only drives flap, with proper control lines; stops at end of movement
- **Preconditions:** Power ON, valid command received
- **Test Inputs:** UART position commands
- **Test Steps:**
  1. Command move
- **Expected Results:** Motor runs only as required; when off, all drive outputs inactive; no stray activity to non-motor outputs
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** Only proper signals observed

### ******************************
### 6. LED Status Indication
### ******************************

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-009
- **Mapped System Requirements:** SYS-REQ-017, SYS-REQ-018, SYS-REQ-019
- **Objective:** LED for current position ON, others OFF. Power LED always ON when system powered
- **Preconditions:** System powered ON
- **Test Inputs:** Move flap via command
- **Test Steps:**
  1. At each position, inspect LEDs
- **Expected Results:** Only correct position LED ON, all others OFF, power LED always ON
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** LEDs indicate states as required

### ******************************
### 7. End-to-End System Behavior
### ******************************

#### Test Case: SYS-TC-010
- **Mapped System Requirements:** SYS-REQ-001, SYS-REQ-013, SYS-REQ-037, SYS-REQ-042
- **Objective:** Verify whole command → action → feedback → status chain under human-perceptible time
- **Preconditions:** System idle, powered ON
- **Test Inputs:** UART command, physical flap movement observable, LED visibility
- **Test Steps:**
  1. Send command, observe movement, observe status LED response
- **Expected Results:** 
  - System responds within “short perceptible time”
  - Flap moves to correct position, feedback confirmed by both ADC/logical state and LED
  - No system hang, no skipped command
- **Pass/Fail Criteria:** All expected results met in normal operation

---

## 5. Compliance Statement
All tests are end-to-end on full system hardware. No unit/integration/architecture or safety/cyber tests included (unless explicitly required by requirements). Test steps and pass/fail reflect only externally observable, system-level results.
